run_notes: SDC voxel-wise on the 8 ST datasets (same cohort as 07-10_s2.4-vol: 5845 subjects, scope=all plus scope=sdc-voxelwise of excluded_subjects.csv), 2mm grid, nearest. correct_out_of_brain=true: the voxels outside the 2mm brain mask are zeroed after resampling and before the constant-column drop, and the subject is kept (tractography leaves the brain: median 0.80% of a map's mass, up to 15.3%). Same choice as the lesion matrix s1.4-vol and as sdc_metadata.csv, so each row sums to disconnection_load_voxels_2mm. Same session name as the 07-10 matrix, told apart by the date prefix of the output directory; not voxel-comparable with 07-10_s2.4-vol (correction off, 291345 columns).
